title: On the Effect of Bit-Level Parameter Perturbations in Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.26280v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this chapter, we investigate how classical machine learning models respond to small, targeted modifications in their parameters. We compare and contrast these results to analogous experiments on deep learning models. For classical learning models, we consider Hidden Markov Models (HMM) and Support Vector Machines (SVM), and for comparison, we conduct analogous experiments involving Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. When applied to the Drebin Android malware dataset, our results show that classical models are brittle, in the sense that a limited set of selected parameters can have a dramatic effect on model behavior. translated_title: 论机器学习与深度学习模型中比特级参数扰动的影响
translated_abstract: 在本章中，我们研究了经典机器学习模型如何响应其参数中微小的、有针对性的修改，并将这些结果与深度学习模型上的类似实验进行对比。对于经典学习模型，我们考虑了隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）和支持向量机（SVM）；作为对比，我们进行了涉及多层感知机（MLP）和长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的类似实验。当应用于Drebin Android恶意软件数据集时，我们的结果表明经典模型是脆弱的，也就是说，一小组选定的参数就能对模型行为产生显著影响。在相关的一系列实验中，我们研究了这些学习模型的隐写容量，即在不显著损害模型性能的前提下，模型参数中可以被覆写的比特比例。我们发现经典模型提供的隐写[容量有限]……
tldr: 经典机器学习模型（如HMM和SVM）对参数的微小比特级扰动极其脆弱，而深度学习模型表现出更强的鲁棒性，且经典模型的隐写容量有限。
en_tdlr: Classical machine learning models (such as HMM and SVM) are brittle to small bit-level parameter perturbations, whereas deep learning models exhibit greater robustness, and classical models offer limited steganographic capacity.
